freeze_policy: Freeze during the bakeoff. Only change for clear factual mistakes, corrupted metadata, or duplicated cases accidentally introduced by the benchmark build itself.
notes: The repo references an existing 100-pair blind core audit but does not store that 100-case merge-only slice as a standalone file. benchmark_v1 freezes a deterministic reconstruction from the final core Chrome ledger and documents the rule above.
No case is duplicated across strata.
This benchmark is for evaluation only. It is not an execution queue and it should not be expanded mid-bakeoff just because more cases exist.

strata.selection_rule: Deterministic merge-only reconstruction of the referenced 100-pair blind core audit from the final 143-case core Chrome ledger: all 30 final MERGE cases plus a proportional fixed-seed sample of 70 final SKIP cases. PARENT_CHILD and DEFERRED cases excluded.
strata.product_risk: Primary core precision/recall bar for visible producers. This is the main check against wrong core merges or obvious missed core merges.

strata.selection_rule: 16 curated representatives from final false-merge corrections (original MERGE, final SKIP) chosen to cover the recurring failure shapes without duplicating the core slice.
strata.product_risk: Direct protection against the most damaging failure mode: collapsing distinct producers into one row.

strata.selection_rule: 16 curated representatives where the final verdict is MERGE but earlier ladder stages showed SKIP or disagreement, focusing on recovered misses and cross-country/global-brand cases.
strata.product_risk: Protects recall on real duplicate pairs the ladder was prone to miss or down-rank.

strata.selection_rule: 20-case fixed-seed random sample from final tail MERGE/SKIP decisions, sampled after excluding named-pattern cases.
strata.product_risk: Keeps the bakeoff honest on long-tail conservatism without letting the benchmark balloon.

cases.rationale: Etruscan Wine Imports confirms 'Stèfen is the ancient surname of the De Stefani family, as written in old documents dated 1624' — Stefen 1624 is a De Stefani cuvée.

Both rows are Domaines Barons de Rothschild Lafite products: side_a has Aussieres (DBR's Languedoc estate Chateau d'Aussieres) + Val Ours; side_b has Champagne + Bordeaux Legende/Saga.

Both rows reference Domaines Barons de Rothschild (Lafite) brand. Side_a has 'Domaines Barons de Rothschild (Lafite)' products explicitly; side_b has DBR's Aussieres/Champagne/Bordeaux Legende products.
BBR confirms same estate: Guy Castagnier started at domaine 1975; since 2004 bottled as Domaine Castagnier; son Jerome succeeded. Per §11.4.f generational succession MERGE stands.
Side_b 'Mondavi' 4 wines are all Robert Mondavi signature bottlings: 50th Anniversary To Kalon Reserve Cabernet, To Kalon Vineyard Reserve, Napa Valley Fume Blanc. Same producer, short form.
Taillevent is Paris restaurant; wine is their restaurant-bottled Chambolle-Musigny from Joseph Drouhin. Per §11.4.p merchant-prefix merge into producer Joseph Drouhin.
Jasper Morris Inside Burgundy confirms: 'This domaine, formerly known as Amiot-Bonfils, was founded by Arsene Amiot in 1920. Guy Amiot took over the reins in 1985'. Same Chassagne-Montrachet estate.

Michel Gassier confirmed as Costieres de Nimes base (Chateau de Nages) who has expanded to Chateauneuf-du-Pape ('Domaine Gassier, Chateauneuf du Pape 2022') and Cairanne (Les Halos de Jupiter). Both rows fit.
Maison Edouard Delaunay produces 'Bourgogne Cote d'Or Pinot Noir' — exactly matching side_b's 'Maison Edouard, Bourgogne, Cote d'Or Rouge'. Short form.
Thomas-Moillard is the domaine branch of Maison Moillard (Nuits-Saint-Georges). 'La Richemone' is a famous NSG 1er Cru bottling under this label. Same house.
Both are Maison Louis Jadot umbrella labels. Chateau des Jacques is Jadot's Beaujolais estate (Moulin-a-Vent Clos du Grand Carquelin is a famous bottling).
Epicure Wines is Franck Massard's distribution company ('empresa distribuidora'), NOT a sub-brand. CellarTracker/Vivino lists 'Alma' Albarino under Franck Massard directly.
Domaine Bertrand Bachelet Pommard Les Chanlins is a confirmed Bertrand Bachelet bottling (wine-searcher, wine.com). 'B. Bachelet' is initial abbreviation.
Henry Lamarche + Nicole Lamarche are generational succession of same Vosne-Romanee estate (La Grande Rue monopole). Well-documented historical transition.

Stadt Krems and Krems both refer to Weingut Stadt Krems (municipal winery, Krems, Kremstal). Side_b wines use Weingut Stadt Krems's cru names (Sandgrube, Goldberg, Wachtberg, Kremsleiten) — direct match.
Benedikt Baltes historically ran Weingut Steintal/Benedikt Baltes in Klingenberg (Franken); 2020 returned to Ahr and merged with wife Julia Bertram's estate → Weingut Bertram-Baltes (Dernau, Ahr).

Domaine Bart (Marsannay) — side_b's single wine 'Andre Bart, Fixin Premier Cru, Hervelets' overlaps with side_a's 'Domaine Bart, Fixin Premier Cru, Hervelets'. Andre Bart is historical name of the same Marsannay estate.
Jacques et Francois Carillon is historical bottling from the old Domaine Louis Carillon et Fils before the 2010 split into Francois Carillon and Jacques Carillon. Child row is 1 wine (Mercurey).
Hermitage Thieuley row is empty (0 wines). Merging into Thieuley (Bordeaux) is safe cleanup.

Both rows are Domaines Barons de Rothschild (Lafite) — specifically side_a 'Lafite Rothschild' (Chateau Lafite + Carruades de Lafite etc.) and side_b 'Barons de Rothschild (Lafite)' (Domaines BR Lafite brand).

Side_a 'La Barrique du Chat Botte, Saint-Romain, Sous la Velle' matches side_b 'Frederic Cossard, Saint-Romain Premier Cru, Sous la Velle' vineyard-exactly. Chat Botte is a merchant/restaurant merge-prefix pattern.
Selaks is a New Zealand wine brand (owned by Constellation NZ). The Australian-tagged wines in side_a are just market mis-tagging — product is the same Selaks brand. MERGE per §11.4.n global brand.

K&L confirms: 'From 100-point phenom Philippe Melka, the Majestique label represents Melka's personal projects from around the world'. Saint-Emilion Le Chatelet is Melka's personal Saint-Emilion project (childhood home).
DBR's China project (Long Dai in Qiushan Valley) labels as 'Domaines Barons de Rothschild (Lafite)'. Same parent brand. MERGE.
Boutinot is a UK-based global wine merchant/producer. CL (Myth of Motu Nui, Aconcagua) and FR (Rhone, Chablis) rows are same Boutinot umbrella. MERGE per §11.4.n.
Same CN DBR Lafite row as 138090. Same parent brand. MERGE into main DBR Lafite.

Jean Rijckaert (Belgian, founded this Jura/Burgundy domaine 1998 with Jean-Marie Guffens) retired in 2013; Florent Rouve took over the estate. Same continuous vineyard holdings. Per §11.4.f succession MERGE.
